scripts.zip: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const { ZipArchive } = require('archiver'); const v = require('./manifest.json').version; if (!fs.existsSync('.release')) fs.mkdirSync('.release'); const fileName = '.release/KD_CM_Notes_v' + v + '.zip'; const out = fs.createWriteStream(fileName); const arch = new ZipArchive(); out.on('close', () => fs.copyFileSync(fileName, '.release/latest.zip')); arch.pipe(out); arch.glob('**/*', { ignore: ['.git/**', '*.zip', '.env*', '*.vscode/**', '.release/**', 'node_modules/**'] }); arch.finalize();"
scripts.release: npm run zip && npm run upload && npm run publish
